Body.Content: Azure Resource Health discloses the health of each of the Azure resources (for example, virtual machines, web apps, and SQL Server databases) to help quickly identify the root cause of an issue. Based on the root cause, it provides actionable guidance and tools to help resolve the issues, including the option to submit a support ticket. Azure Resource Health is in public preview, and it can be accessed via the Azure preview portal. For more information, please visit the Azure blog, Reducing troubleshooting time with Azure Resource health.
